text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The day of our clash against Narita Taishin at the spring Tenno Sho has arrived.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The switch in venue from the Kyoto Racecourse to the Hanshin Racecourse has necessitated some adjustments to the winning equation, but Biwa Hayahide isn't worried.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her fighting spirit burns brightly within her as she aims for first place.
